description.zh: 应用配置。数组元素个数N的取值范围：1~1000。
description.en: The application configurations. The number of array elements N must be in the range of 1 to 1000.

description.zh: 应用列表。数组元素个数N的取值范围：1~100。
description.en: The list of applications. The number of array elements N must be in the range of 1 to 100.

description.zh: 引导脚本数组。数组元素个数N的取值范围：1~10。
description.en: The array of bootstrap scripts. The number of array elements N must be in the range of 1 to 10.

description.zh: 幂等客户端TOKEN。同一个ClientToken多次调用的返回结果一致，同一个ClientToken最多只创建一个集群。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The results of multiple calls that use the same client token are the same. A maximum of one cluster can be created with the same client token.

description.zh: 集群名称。长度为1~128个字符，必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以 http:// 和 https:// 开头。可以包含中文、英文、数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）、半角句号（.）或者短划线（-）
description.en: The cluster name. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://. It can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, colons (:), underscores (\_), periods (.), and hyphens (-).

description.zh:
集群类型。取值范围：
- DATALAKE：新版数据湖。
- OLAP：数据分析。
- DATAFLOW：实时数据流。
- DATASERVING：数据服务。
- CUSTOM：自定义混部集群。
- HADOOP：旧版数据湖（不推荐使用，建议使用新版数据湖）。

如果您在2022年12月19日17点（UTC+8）以后第一次创建EMR集群，不能选择HADOOP、DATA_SCIENCE、PRESTO、ZOOKEEPER集群类型。
description.en:
The cluster type. Valid values:

- DATALAKE: new data lake.

- OLAP: data analytics.

- DATAFLOW: real-time data stream.

- DATASERVING: data serving.

- CUSTOM: custom cluster.

- HADOOP: earlier-version data lake. We recommend that you use the new data lake.

If you create an EMR cluster for the first time after 17:00 (UTC+8) on December 19, 2022, you cannot select HADOOP, DATA\_SCIENCE, PRESTO, or ZOOKEEPER as the cluster type.

description.zh:
集群是否开启删除保护。取值范围：
- true：开启删除保护。
- false：不开启删除保护。

默认值：false。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable deletion protection for the cluster. Valid values:

- true: enables deletion protection.

- false: disables deletion protection.

Default value: false.

description.zh:
集群中的应用部署模式。取值范围：
- NORMAL（默认值）：非高可用部署。集群1个MASTER节点。
- HA：高可用部署。高可用部署要求至少3个MASTER节点。
description.en:
The deployment mode of applications in the cluster. Valid values:

- NORMAL (default): non-high availability (HA) deployment. The cluster has one master node.

- HA: HA deployment. An HA deployment requires at least three master nodes.

description.zh: 节点属性。集群所有ECS节点基础属性。
description.en: The node attributes. This parameter specifies the basic attributes of all Elastic Compute Service (ECS) nodes in the cluster.

description.zh: 节点组配置数组。数组元素个数N的取值范围：1~100。
description.en: The array of node group configurations. The number of array elements N must be in the range of 1 to 100.

description.zh:
付费类型。取值范围：
- PayAsYouGo：后付费。
- Subscription：预付费。

默认值：PayAsYouGo。
description.en:
The billing method. Valid values:

- PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go.

- Subscription: subscription.

Default value: PayAsYouGo.

description.zh: EMR发行版。可通过EMR集群售卖页面查看EMR发行版。
description.en: The EMR release version. You can find the EMR release versions on the EMR cluster purchase page.

description.zh:
集群Kerberos安全模式。取值范围：
- NORMAL（默认值）：普通模式，不开启Kerberos模式。
- KERBEROS：开启Kerberos模式。
description.en:
The Kerberos security mode of the cluster. Valid values:

- NORMAL (default): normal mode. Kerberos is disabled.

- KERBEROS: Kerberos mode. Kerberos is enabled.

description.zh: 预付费配置。当PaymentType取值为Subscription时必填。
description.en: The subscription configurations. This parameter is required if you set PaymentType to Subscription.

description.zh: 标签。数组元数个数N的取值范围：0~20。
description.en: The tags. The number of array elements N must be in the range of 0 to 20.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun emr create-cluster --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmzabjyop0000 --payment-type PayAsYouGo --subscription-config example-string --cluster-type DATALAKE --release-version EMR-5.16.0 --cluster-name emrtest --deploy-mode HA --security-mode NORMAL --applications example-string --application-configs example-string --node-attributes example-string --node-groups '["example-string"]' --bootstrap-scripts '["example-string"]' --tags example-string --client-token A7D960FA-6DBA-5E07-8746-A63E3E4D0000 --description Emr_cluster_for_ETL --deletion-protection false --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun emr CreateCluster --region cn-hangzhou --Tags.1 'example-string' --Description Emr_cluster_for_ETL --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzabjyop0000' --Applications.1 'example-string' --ClusterType DATALAKE --DeletionProtection false --ApplicationConfigs.1 'example-string' --ReleaseVersion 'EMR-5.16.0' --BootstrapScripts.1 'example-string' --SubscriptionConfig 'example-string' --DeployMode HA --SecurityMode NORMAL --NodeAttributes 'example-string' --PaymentType PayAsYouGo --ClusterName emrtest --NodeGroups.1 'example-string' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken 'A7D960FA-6DBA-5E07-8746-A63E3E4D0000' --method POST --force
